title: Honda Pilot / Passport / Ridgeline 9-speed: engine won't auto-restart after idle stop, starter and valve adjustment (10 years)
summary: Honda Service Bulletin 23-009: after idle stop the engine may not restart on its own because of high cylinder pressure and/or low cranking torque. Honda covers a new starter, starter cut relays and a valve adjustment for 10 years with no mileage limit. Includes the 3.5 V6 valve clearance specs and order.

specs.name: Warranty extension
specs.value: Starter assembly, starter relays and valve adjustment for this condition: 10 years from original purchase, no mileage limit

specs.name: Valve clearance, intake
specs.value: 0.20-0.24 mm (0.008-0.009 in); set to 0.22 mm for this repair

specs.name: Valve clearance, exhaust
specs.value: 0.28-0.32 mm (0.011-0.012 in); set to 0.30 mm for this repair

specs.name: Adjusting order (TDC marks on the front cam pulley)
Rocker adjusting screw locknuts
specs.value: 20 N·m (15 lb-ft), intake and exhaust, oiled threads

specs.name: Labor
specs.value: 2.8 hr Pilot, 2.9 hr Ridgeline, 3.0 hr Passport

steps.text: If Product Update 23-008 (idle stop PGM-FI software) applies to the VIN and is still open, do that first; it completes the repair. If it's closed or doesn't apply, verify the no-restart symptom and continue.
Replace the starter and both starter cut relays, then use HDS to run IDLE STOP STARTER COUNTER CLEAR in the adjustment menu.
Remove the throttle body (new gasket), EGR pipe B, intake manifold (bolts and nuts in three steps), ignition coils and both cylinder head covers.

With coolant below 100 °F (38 °C), set No. 1 at TDC on the front cam pulley mark. Check each valve with a feeler gauge for a slight drag; adjust intake to 0.22 mm and exhaust to 0.30 mm, holding the screw while tightening the oiled locknut to 20 N·m (15 lb-ft), then recheck.
Turn the crank clockwise to each TDC mark in order and do cylinders 4, 2, 5, 3 and 6 the same way.

Check the spark plug tube seals, clean and seat the head cover gaskets, put new liquid gasket on the rocker arm oil control valve mating surfaces, and reassemble: intake manifold in three steps, throttle body in a cross pattern in three steps.

body: Service Bulletin 23-009 lists 2016-21 Pilot, 2019-21 Passport and 2020-21 Ridgeline. Honda's owner letter for the same extension (which references bulletins 23-009 and 23-010) names 2016-22 Pilot, 2019-22 Passport and 2020-23 Ridgeline; the applies ranges follow the letter. Eligibility is by VIN.
